scope: IEEE-118 fixed-PV/PQ single-slack calibration profile; research methods remain contract variables

capabilities.name: scenario
capabilities.expansion: Versioned scenario input manifest and independent input policy validation required

capabilities.name: sampling
capabilities.expansion: Candidate sampler interface plus seeded input manifests, cost accounting and coverage protocol required

capabilities.name: solver
capabilities.implementation: MATPOWER/Octave Newton reference with bounded maximum iterations
capabilities.expansion: New/custom solver must implement asr-candidate/1:solver and pass actual isolated execution capability admission

capabilities.name: comparison
capabilities.expansion: Frozen seed/resource/evaluation/denominator protocol, repeated trials and uncertainty required

capabilities.name: independent_replication
capabilities.expansion: Independent evaluation identity, isolated frozen strategy execution and signed service report required

execution: asr_supervisor DockerBackend; no researcher Docker socket
unsupported_behavior: explicit capability_unavailable; never substitute reference for a novel candidate
installation_policy: existing local packages only; no automatic external toolkit installation
